title: Location
description: A location entity as published in PublicGame.locations. This map holds two structurally disjoint shapes from two different production encoders, disambiguated below by a 'oneOf': (1) an ordinary Arkham.Location.Base.LocationAttrs plus the computed connection/occupant fields Arkham.Game.withLocationConnectionData merges in, and (2) an enemy-spawned pseudo-location (Arkham.Location.EnemyLocation) built by Arkham.Game.withEnemyLocationAsLocationData, tagged 'enemyLocation': true. Matcher, cost, and card-union payloads remain intentionally broad; see the field descriptions below for exactly what is out of scope in this slice.

ordinaryLocation.title: OrdinaryLocation
ordinaryLocation.description: A location entity as published in PublicGame.locations (Arkham.Location.Base.LocationAttrs plus the computed connection/occupant fields Arkham.Game.withLocationConnectionData merges in). Matcher, cost, and card-union payloads remain intentionally broad; see the field descriptions below for exactly what is out of scope in this slice.

tokens.description: A Token-keyed multiset (e.g. clues, doom, resources), encoded as an array of [tokenName, count] pairs.

connectedMatchers.description: Unrevealed-side connection matchers (Arkham.Matcher.Location.LocationMatcher). Broad and out of scope for this contract slice.

revealedConnectedMatchers.description: Revealed-side connection matchers (Arkham.Matcher.Location.LocationMatcher). Broad and out of scope for this contract slice.

directions.description: A Direction-keyed map of grid-adjacent location ids, encoded as an array of [direction, [locationId, ...]] pairs. Empty for every non-grid scenario (including this fixture's Night of the Zealot board), so the populated pair shape is not asserted here.

connectsTo.description: The set of grid Directions (Above, Below, LeftOf, RightOf) this location opens toward. Empty outside grid-based scenarios.

cardsUnderneath.description: Cards physically stacked underneath this location. Broad card union, out of scope for this contract slice.

keys.description: Arkham keys placed on this location. Broad (ArkhamKey nests a ChaosToken and recurses), out of scope for this contract slice.

seals.description: Scarlet Keys campaign seals placed on this location. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

floodLevel.description: Edge of the Earth flood-level marker. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

brazier.description: Edge of the Earth brazier state. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

breaches.description: Breach/collapse status. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

globalMeta.description: Free-form shared scenario metadata, keyed by arbitrary string keys.

position.description: The grid position, when this location is placed on a grid-based board. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

concealedCards.description: Concealed-card ids hidden at this location. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

connectedLocations.description: Computed at snapshot time from directions and the revealed connection matchers: the LocationId (UUID) of locations currently reachable from here.

investigators.description: Computed at snapshot time: InvestigatorId (card code) of investigators currently at this location.

enemies.description: Computed at snapshot time: EnemyId (UUID) values at or attached to this location.

assets.description: Computed at snapshot time: AssetId (UUID) values at or attached to this location.

events.description: Computed at snapshot time: EventId (UUID) values at or attached to this location.

treacheries.description: Computed at snapshot time: TreacheryId (UUID) values at or attached to this location.

scarletKeys.description: Computed at snapshot time: ScarletKeyId (card code) values at this location.

modifiers.description: Active modifiers targeting this location. Broad and additive, out of scope for this contract slice.

enemyLocationView.title: EnemyLocationView
enemyLocationView.description: An enemy-spawned pseudo-location, produced by Arkham.Game.withEnemyLocationAsLocationData for entries in gameEntities.entitiesEnemyLocations (Arkham.Location.EnemyLocation). This is a materially smaller, disjoint field set from an ordinary LocationAttrs-backed location: it always carries 'enemyLocation': true and 'exhausted', and omits ordinary-only fields such as 'symbol'/'revealedSymbol'/'directions'/'connectsTo'/'meta'/'position' entirely (the encoder builds a fixed literal object, not LocationAttrs's own encoding).

enemyLocation.description: Always true; the literal tag distinguishing this branch from an ordinary Location.
